obligations.obligation: Expose separate agent creation, session creation/resume/list/delete, and close operations.
obligations.mutation: Remove resume_session or replace create and resume with one method.

obligations.obligation: Expose session info, run, start_turn, fork, history, and close.
obligations.mutation: Omit fork or expose writable session info.

obligations.obligation: Expose immutable turn identity, one async event consumer with stream_already_consumed on reuse, and cancellation.
obligations.mutation: Allow a second event consumer or caller mutation of turn identity.

obligations.obligation: run and streamed execution follow identical behavior and return equal terminal results.
obligations.mutation: Make run bypass approval or discard terminal error/usage fields.

obligations.obligation: Carry the required input, message, result, text-part, session, and event record fields.
obligations.mutation: Rename session_id, remove TurnInput.history, or change terminal result field types.

obligations.obligation: Accept only the four registered conversation roles and text content parts.
obligations.mutation: Accept a tool role or an image content part.

obligations.obligation: Agent construction resolves to a ready usable agent or a named error.
obligations.mutation: Return an agent before initialization finishes or suppress initialization failure.

obligations.obligation: Agent/session close is idempotent and cancels active work while draining paired events.
obligations.mutation: Return from close with an unresolved tool call or fail the second close.

obligations.obligation: Operations on closed objects fail with closed.
obligations.mutation: Allow create_session or start_turn after the parent object closes.

obligations.obligation: Independent agents do not exchange configuration or runtime state.
obligations.mutation: Store tool handlers or instructions in one mutable process-global slot.

obligations.obligation: Agent options expose the registered groups, including skills as source locations.
obligations.mutation: Add a routing-table option or accept runtime skill objects instead of source locations.

obligations.obligation: Agent options are captured once and cannot mutate the constructed agent.
obligations.mutation: Read instructions or tool declarations again after caller mutation.

obligations.obligation: Refuse unknown and unsupported construction fields by name with an actionable remedy.
obligations.mutation: Ignore an unregistered or recognized-but-unhonored option.

obligations.obligation: Refuse duplicate tool names and caller tools without handlers during construction.
obligations.mutation: Silently select one duplicate tool or defer a missing handler until execution.

obligations.obligation: Resolve ambient settings before applying overriding AgentOptions.
obligations.mutation: Let environment model override the explicit AgentOptions model.

obligations.obligation: Generate lowercase UUIDv4 session ids; validate supplied ids against the contracted pattern.
obligations.mutation: Generate UUIDv1 or accept an uppercase, short, or overlength caller id.

obligations.obligation: Treat accepted session ids as opaque in consumers.
obligations.mutation: Require consumers to extract workspace or time information from an accepted id.

obligations.obligation: Durable persistence is the default and survives close and process replacement.
obligations.mutation: Default to ephemeral state or require an old process to resume.

obligations.obligation: Ephemeral sessions cannot resume after close.
obligations.mutation: Persist and resume a closed ephemeral session.

obligations.obligation: Create and resume remain distinct; duplicate, missing, and live durable ids yield their registered errors.
obligations.mutation: Create a missing id during resume or admit a second live durable handle.

obligations.obligation: Later turns observe prior terminal turns; concurrent turns on one session fail busy instead of queueing.
obligations.mutation: Queue a second start_turn or omit a completed turn from subsequent provider input.

obligations.obligation: Separate sessions can progress concurrently without sharing conversation.
obligations.mutation: Block one session behind another's tool or copy history between sessions.

obligations.obligation: Fork snapshots parent context into a separate generated id, inherits persistence, and rejects active parents.
obligations.mutation: Share the parent's mutable history, change persistence, or fork while busy.

obligations.obligation: Delete removes durable state irreversibly; missing and live ids fail with not_found and session_in_use.
obligations.mutation: Delete a live session or allow deleted history to reappear on resume.

obligations.obligation: Supplied history is accepted only by an unused empty ephemeral session and never replaces a seed.
obligations.mutation: Accept history on a durable, used, or inherited conversation.

obligations.obligation: Seed messages precede content; nonempty content adds one user message and empty content adds none.
obligations.mutation: Duplicate appended content or invent a trailing user message after assistant history.

obligations.obligation: Empty history combined with empty content is invalid_input.
obligations.mutation: Accept empty combined input and contact the provider.

obligations.obligation: Snapshot supplied messages at acceptance, retaining role, order, text, and part boundaries.
obligations.mutation: Flatten adjacent parts or observe caller edits made after acceptance.

obligations.obligation: Historical system/developer roles remain context and cannot replace agent configuration.
obligations.mutation: Replace instructions or approval policy with a supplied system message.

obligations.obligation: Reject unsupported history before stream/provider/executor activity with a field-specific remedy, without consuming first-turn eligibility.
obligations.mutation: Open a stream, mutate history, or mark the first turn used before validation fails.

obligations.obligation: Closed and busy restrictions continue to apply to supplied-history turns.
obligations.mutation: Allow seeded input on a closed session or during an active turn.

obligations.obligation: Seed context persists through later turns and reaches forks exactly once.
obligations.mutation: Drop the seed on turn two or replay it twice in a fork.

obligations.obligation: Imported history creates no past turns, ids, events, results, or usage; actual recorded input retains the seed.
obligations.mutation: Fabricate completed history turns or remove supplied history from the actual input record.

obligations.obligation: Seed processing contributes only to current model usage and the first seeded turn is fresh.
obligations.mutation: Charge fabricated historical usage or label the first seeded turn resumed.

obligations.section: 4. The conversation stays on the caller's side
obligations.obligation: The local transcript is authoritative; every provider request carries complete input without a load-bearing conversation handle.
obligations.mutation: Send only a last message plus previous_response_id or depend on provider memory.

obligations.section: 4. The conversation stays on the caller's side
obligations.obligation: Disable provider retention unless the host explicitly opts in.
obligations.mutation: Omit a required retention-disable parameter or enable storage by default.

obligations.section: 4. The conversation stays on the caller's side
obligations.obligation: Durable history survives loss of every process between completed turns and resumes from local state alone.
obligations.mutation: Lose the last completed turn after killing caller, engine, and provider processes.

obligations.section: 5. One provider, and the model is a ceiling
obligations.obligation: An agent has one provider and rejects a second.
obligations.mutation: Accept a provider list or switch provider during fallback.

obligations.section: 5. One provider, and the model is a ceiling
obligations.obligation: Agent, session, and turn model choices form downward-only ceilings within that provider.
obligations.mutation: Permit an upward session refinement or route delegated work above the ceiling.

obligations.section: 5. One provider, and the model is a ceiling
obligations.obligation: Primary work uses the named model or fails selector_rejected without silent substitution.
obligations.mutation: Replace the requested primary model with a cheaper fallback and return success.

obligations.section: 5. One provider, and the model is a ceiling
obligations.obligation: Internal routing remains hidden and every primary/internal/delegated actual selection is accounted for.
obligations.mutation: Omit a delegated model from final usage or expose routing decisions as events.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Tools have exactly one executor selected by source: engine, caller process, or configured MCP process.
obligations.mutation: Execute a caller handler in the engine worker or execute an MCP effect twice.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Every effect is preceded by a source-named tool_call; the engine does not run caller code.
obligations.mutation: Perform an effect before publishing its tool_call or serialize caller code into a worker.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: The provider receives one flat tool set and each tool event identifies its executor source.
obligations.mutation: Hide an MCP tool from selection or omit the source on a tool result.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Visibility, veto, and truthful resolution apply to built-in, caller, and MCP effects equally.
obligations.mutation: Bypass approvals for a built-in or delegated effect.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Caller declarations include stable name, description, JSON Schema with $schema, and optional descriptive safety data.
obligations.mutation: Accept a schema missing $schema or use safety metadata as an approval grant.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Each invocation receives decoded strict JSON arguments, a correlated call_id, and any supplied deadline.
obligations.mutation: Pass encoded JSON text, NaN, a wrong call_id, or lose the deadline.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: A tool resolves once as completed, failed, cancelled, or unknown.
obligations.mutation: Emit two tool results or convert unknown to completed.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Distinguish unreachable/dead callback, malformed/miscorrelated/duplicate result, reported failure, and uncertain outcome.
obligations.mutation: Flatten all executor failures to tool_failed or accept a mismatched result id.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: Tool errors terminate as failure except uncertain completion following an accepted cancellation.
obligations.mutation: Continue to success after tool_failed or overwrite accepted cancellation with uncertain failure.

obligations.section: 6. Tools: the model decides when, the executor does the work
obligations.obligation: An uncertain effect is never retried or claimed undone, and replies after settlement have no effect.
obligations.mutation: Retry a possibly completed effect or publish a second resolution from a late reply.

obligations.section: 7. Approvals: the caller's veto, before execution
obligations.obligation: A configured approval handler sees every consequential action before execution; otherwise only explicit static policy decides.
obligations.mutation: Infer allow when no policy exists or execute before the callback answers.

obligations.section: 7. Approvals: the caller's veto, before execution
obligations.obligation: Deny rejects, approval cancel cancels, and timeout/unavailable/malformed replies fail with their registered codes.
obligations.mutation: Treat timeout as allow or map denial to failure instead of rejected.

obligations.section: 7. Approvals: the caller's veto, before execution
obligations.obligation: Non-allow decisions never authorize an effect and late decisions cannot change a settled result.
obligations.mutation: Run a tool after a late allow following an authoritative denial.

obligations.obligation: The event stream is the observation channel and exactly one terminal follows all paired resolutions.
obligations.mutation: End the stream with a pending approval or emit a second terminal.

obligations.obligation: Repeated cancellation is harmless; accepted cancellation stops new work and fixes turn_cancelled.
obligations.mutation: Start another model/tool request after accepted cancellation or report success.

obligations.obligation: Every started stream eventually reports a terminal rather than requiring callers to infer completion from silence.
obligations.mutation: Close the connection without a terminal or leave it hanging after provider failure.

obligations.obligation: A native error preserves code, category, message, remedy, retryability, and optional correlation/details.
obligations.mutation: Translate an error into a string or drop details/remedy during transport.

obligations.obligation: Every remedy is actionable; retryable means the identical request may succeed.
obligations.mutation: Offer a generic retry remedy for invalid input or mark an unchanged invalid request retryable.

obligations.obligation: Error categories and codes use the registered vocabulary or valid owned code extensions.
obligations.mutation: Introduce an unqualified transport_error code or a new category.

obligations.obligation: Failures before stream creation occur at the method; later failures occur in terminal records.
obligations.mutation: Raise an untyped iterator exception after turn_started or create a stream for invalid history.

obligations.obligation: Usage snapshots group exact integer counters by actual provider/model, including the four named token counters.
obligations.mutation: Round a counter above 2^53, combine different models, or fabricate a counter.

obligations.obligation: Known costs use ISO-4217 decimal-string amounts and faithful native decimals; unknown costs remain absent.
obligations.mutation: Round through binary float, use an unregistered currency key, or replace unknown cost with zero.

obligations.obligation: Usage events replace cumulative snapshots; the final snapshot precedes terminal and covers all actual selections.
obligations.mutation: Treat snapshots as increments, omit final model work, or report absent counters as zero.

obligations.obligation: Expose agent-interface/1 without invoking work; public contract versions are distinct from release versions.
obligations.mutation: Require engine startup to read contract_version or use the package version as its value.

obligations.obligation: The engine connection exposes no separately versioned protocol.
obligations.mutation: Require binding callers or replacement authors to negotiate an independent protocol version.

obligations.obligation: Reachable public types, fields, enum values, and errors cannot name denied internals.
obligations.mutation: Export bundle, orchestrator, prompt assembly, routing-table, or storage-format controls.

obligations.obligation: Keep assembly private; a missing benefit does not justify adding an excluded control.
obligations.mutation: Solve a missing capability by publishing engine composition options.

obligations.obligation: Public types, errors, paths, and artifacts do not reveal the engine language.
obligations.mutation: Expose an engine-specific Python type or require a Python executable path from TS callers.

obligations.obligation: Every effect is visible, correlated, settled once, and truthful about uncertainty.
obligations.mutation: Execute a hidden delegated effect or report uncertain completion as successful.

obligations.obligation: Exclude composition, loop observers, prompt assembly, routing roles, storage format, context knobs, CLI, modes, and recipes.
obligations.mutation: Export an orchestrator hook or ship a supported agent command interface.

obligations.obligation: Exclude multi-provider agents and resume-or-create behavior.
obligations.mutation: Add a convenience resume that creates absent ids or a cross-provider agent option.

obligations.obligation: Runtime conformance uses discriminating scripted-provider cases across every listed interface family.
obligations.mutation: Claim interface compatibility while omitting cancellation races or seed atomic-refusal fixtures.

obligations.obligation: Include public denylist and record-shape lint in interface conformance.
obligations.mutation: Declare compatibility after runtime tests while exporting a forbidden public option.

obligations.obligation: Repeat interface scenarios after engine replacement using new sessions.
obligations.mutation: Validate only a provider swap or require old-format sessions to establish replacement acceptance.

obligations.obligation: Changes within the agent-interface major version remain additive.
obligations.mutation: Remove a result field or make an optional option mandatory within agent-interface/1.
